IdEst continuous fill scales for ggplot2

Source: R/style.R
scale_fill_idest_c.Rd

IdEst continuous fill scales for ggplot2

Usage

scale_fill_idest_c(palette_name = "all_color_idest", direction = 1, ...)

Arguments

palette_name

The name of the palette to use. The available palette are c("all_color_idest", "ligth_color_idest", "dark_color_idest", "Picabia", "Picasso", "Levine2", "Rattner", "Sidhu", "Hokusai2", "Hokusai3"). See [idest_pal] for more details.

direction

Direction of the palette. 1 for standard, -1 for reversed.

...

Additional arguments passed to [ggplot2::scale_color_gradientn()].

Value

A ggplot2 scale object.

Author

Adrien Taudiere
